introduction.label: 01 — Overview
introduction.heading: Business thinking, editorial sensitivity.
introduction.paragraph1: I am an International Business Management student with a dedicated focus on the global luxury sector, client relationships, and business operations.
introduction.paragraph2: My academic grounding and current internship at Christian Louboutin provide daily exposure to the systems, data precision, and human touches that underpin enduring luxury maisons.
introduction.quote: “Luxury is felt in the details people remember.”

experience.label: 02 — Experience
experience.summary: Developing practical immersion in luxury retail operations, CRM systems, client relationship management, and data consistency. Focused on how meticulous back-office coordination drives flawless front-facing client experiences.
learningAreas: Operational coordination within a global luxury house
experience.disclaimer: This portfolio presents individual academic studies and career perspectives. It implies no official sponsorship or corporate representation of Christian Louboutin.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Dedicated to the art of detail in global business.
aboutPage.heroIntro: Yuga is an International Business Management student based in Paris, currently undertaking an internship at Christian Louboutin. Her work sits at the intersection of business rigor and luxury sensibility.
aboutPage.backgroundBody1: With an international upbringing and an intrinsic appreciation for craftsmanship, Yuga approaches business management through both analytical frameworks and cultural understanding.
aboutPage.backgroundBody2: Her academic journey in International Business Management has provided a robust foundation in strategic analysis, finance, international trade, and cross-cultural leadership.
aboutPage.educationDetails: Curriculum focused on global market strategies, corporate finance, international negotiations, consumer behavior, and enterprise operations.
aboutPage.experienceDetails: Assisting with CRM maintenance, operational synchronization, retail reporting, and the continuous enhancement of luxury client touchpoints.
